title: S010 Drop caps
reproduces: GAPS S010: a drop cap set as <span> with float: left; font-size: 3em; line-height: 100% and no width. validateFloats rejects a non-replaced float with width: auto because shrink-to-fit width (CSS 2.1 §10.3.5) is not implemented, so the chapter falls back to Legacy (reason float).
